title: DOS for removal of delegates
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The delegation system on `vePeg.sol` has the feature that `MAX_DELEGATES` is a hardcoded value  On the other hand, users can create locks with only 1 wei LP because `_create_lock()` only has this check `require(_value > 0);`  Now, take this scenario:  Alice owns vePeg_NFT_01 (with big weight) and she decides to delegate it to Bob  Malicious user back-run Alice transaction and delegated to Alice a `MAX_DELEGATES` vePeg_NFT (only 1 wei LP)  After a period, Alice will try to move her delegates of the vePeg_NFT_01 from Bob, but it
